name: Semji
description:
Semji is a content platform for marketing teams. It helps them plan, score and improve content so it performs both on search engines (SEO) and in AI answers (GEO), while keeping the brand's own voice.

This connector gives Claude access to your Semji workspaces so the editorial workflow can be driven in conversation:

- Browse workspaces, folders and the content pipeline, with the same filters as the app
- Create content drafts in the planning, in bulk from a list of titles, focus keywords and URLs
- Set a focus keyword on a content and run its SEO and GEO analysis
- Read the resulting Content Score and the typed recommendations per surface: Google Search, Google AI Overview and ChatGPT
- Update, assign and organise drafts, and mark a content as published
- Launch AI drafting on a content and resolve it, with an explicit confirm step before anything is applied to the draft

Access follows the app's own permissions. A user only ever reaches the workspaces their Semji account already has access to, every call is scoped to their organization, and AI drafting is never applied to a draft without an explicit confirm.

Semji is used by marketing and SEO teams who own a measurable content pipeline. This connector is aimed at those teams, so they can keep working on that pipeline without leaving Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Semji to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Semji to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.semji.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Semji MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Semji lists 18 MCP tools, including browse-folders, browse-users, check-content-generation, create-contents, create-folder, delete-content, delete-folder, find-contents, find-workspaces, get-account, get-content-seo-geo-analysis, and publish-content.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Semji?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Semji in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Semji requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Semji is developed by Semji. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
